description: This file contains partial class definitions, extensions, and storage implementation related to DynamoDB integration within Orleans framework. It includes configuration options, service collection extensions, silo builder extensions, and the DynamoDB grain storage class implementation.

classes.name: DynamoDBGrainStorageOptionsValidator
classes.description: Validator class for DynamoDB storage options, implements IConfigurationValidator, likely used for validating configuration settings.

classes.name: DynamoDBStorageOptions
classes.description: Configuration class for DynamoDB storage options, including properties like CreateIfNotExists, DeleteStateOnClear, ServiceId, TableName, TTL, throughput settings, and serializer options.

classes.name: DynamoDBClientOptions
classes.description: Configuration class for DynamoDB client settings, including access key, secret key, service, token, and profile name.

classes.name: DynamoDBGrainStorage
classes.description: Main class implementing IGrainStorage interface for DynamoDB, managing storage operations such as Read, Write, Clear, and lifecycle participation.

classes.name: DynamoDBGrainStorageFactory
classes.description: Factory class providing method to create DynamoDBGrainStorage instances using a service provider and name.

methods.name: DynamoDBStorageOptions.CreateIfNotExists
methods.description: Boolean property indicating if storage should be created if not existing.

methods.name: DynamoDBStorageOptions.DeleteStateOnClear
methods.description: Boolean property indicating if state should be deleted on clear.

methods.name: DynamoDBStorageOptions.UpdateIfExists
methods.description: Flag indicating if update should occur only if item exists.

methods.name: DynamoDBGrainStorage
methods.description: Constructor initializes DynamoDB storage with configuration and logging.

methods.name: DynamoDBGrainStorageFactory.Create
methods.description: Creates an instance of DynamoDBGrainStorage using service provider and name.
